model_annotation: This plot illustrates the “Missing Step” metric for three different models, represented by lines plotted against a linear x-axis. The x-axis, labeled “Step”, ranges from 0 to approximately 4.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1.0. The y-axis, labeled “Missing Step”, extends from 0.820 to 0.860, with tick intervals of 0.010. A blue dashed line, marked with circle markers, begins at approximately 0.850 and decreases to approximately 0.820. A orange solid line begins at approximately 0.850 and decreases to approximately 0.830. A dashed blue line begins at approximately 0.850 and decreases to approximately 0.820.
